description: Source code for the AudioTrackBridge class, which manages audio playback via JNI on Android, including creation, control, and data writing methods.

classes.name: AudioTrackBridge
classes.description: Manages Android audio track via JNI, including creation, playback control, data writing, and timestamp retrieval.

methods.name: AudioTrackBridge
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the audio track bridge with specified parameters, creating JNI objects and allocating buffers.

methods.name: ~AudioTrackBridge
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up JNI references and destroys the audio track bridge.

methods.name: GetMinBufferSizeInFrames
methods.description: Static method to get minimum buffer size in frames based on sample type, channels, and sampling frequency.

methods.name: PauseAndFlush
methods.description: Pauses and flushes the audio buffer to discard unplayed data.

methods.name: WriteSample
methods.description: Writes float samples to the audio track.

methods.name: WriteSample
methods.description: Writes uint16 samples to the audio track with synchronization time.

methods.name: WriteSample
methods.description: Writes byte samples to the audio track with synchronization time.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume of the audio track.

methods.name: GetAudioTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio timestamp and frame position.

methods.name: GetAndResetHasAudioDeviceChanged
methods.description: Checks and resets the flag indicating if the audio device has changed.

methods.name: GetUnderrunCount
methods.description: Returns the underrun count of the audio track.

methods.name: GetStartThresholdInFrames
methods.description: Returns the start threshold in frames for the audio track.
